records.text: Announce to the regions among the Assyrians and to Egypt’s regions: “Gather upon Samaria’s mountain and see the many astonishing things in her midst and the oppression within her!”
Hear this word, heifers of Bashan on Samaria’s mountain, who oppress the poor and trample the needy, who say to their masters, “Give to us so that we may drink!”

triples.relationship: same-book identification of oppression on Samaria's mountain
triples.rationale: Amos 3 summons outsiders to Samaria's mountain to see the oppression within it. Amos 4 addresses the heifers of Bashan on that same mountain and specifies their oppression of the poor and trampling of the needy. The later charge makes the earlier announced oppression more particular.
